Name: DeclareCommandSort
Content:
create table #sort(sort varchar(1024), [type] tinyint, alias varchar(1024), cookie varchar(128), structure varchar(1024))
insert into #sort select @@sort, @@type, case when @@alias = '' then @@sort else @@alias end, @@cookie + 'lookup', @@structure

Name: FilterInitialize
Content:
<![CDATA[
declare @$primeAlias varchar(32), @$primeJoin varchar(4000), @$primeFilter nvarchar(4000), @$detailPartition varchar(4000), @$detailAlias varchar(4000), @$detailFilter nvarchar(4000)
create table #_f(i int identity(1, 1), datasource varchar(32), type tinyint, filterkey nvarchar(4000), alias varchar(32), xtype tinyint, refKey varchar(128), exRefKey varchar(128), refdatasource varchar(32), refalias varchar(32), fieldKey varchar(128), joinClause varchar(512), orderField varchar(1024), orderCookie varchar(128), orderAlias varchar(1024), orderType tinyint, orderStruct varchar(1024), sortField varchar(1024))
select @$primeAlias = '', @$primeJoin = '', @$primeFilter = '', @$detailPartition = '', @$detailAlias = '', @$detailFilter = ''

if object_id('tempdb..#filter') is not null begin
  insert into #_f(datasource, type, filterkey, xtype, refKey, exRefKey, refdatasource, fieldKey, joinClause, orderField)
    select isnull(b.xtable, ''), '1', replace(case when b.conditionalreplace is null then a.conditional else replace(a.conditional, char(255) + a.field, replace(replace(b.conditionalreplace, b.name, a.field), '%2', '%l')) end, char(255) + a.field, case when charindex(char(254), isnull(b.exname, '')) > 0 then '' else '%[a].' end + isnull(replace(replace(b.exname, '%2', '%l'), char(254), ''), a.field)), case when b.conditionalreplace is null then a.type else 0 end, b.fieldkey, b.exfieldkey, b.reftable, b.reffieldkey, isnull(b.joinclause, ''), a.field
      from #filter a join @@sysDatabaseName..sysfilterdeclares b on b.controller = ]]>&Controller;<![CDATA[ and a.field = replace(b.name, '%2', '%l')

  if object_id('tempdb..#sort') is not null
    if exists(select 1 from #sort where [type] > 0) begin
      update #_f set orderCookie = s.cookie, orderAlias = s.alias, orderType = s.[type], orderStruct = s.structure,
          sortField = case when b.conditionalreplace is null then case when b.exname is null and (s.alias like '%[+*/\-]%' or s.alias like '%when%') then s.alias else '[a].' + replace(isnull(b.exname, b.name), '%2', '%l') end
            else replace(replace(replace(b.conditionalreplace, b.name, s.sort), '%2', ''), char(255) + s.sort, case when charindex(char(254), isnull(b.exname, '')) > 0 then '' else '%[a].' end + isnull(replace(replace(b.exname, '%2', ''), char(254), ''), s.sort)) end
        from #_f a join #sort s on a.orderField = s.sort join @@sysDatabaseName..sysfilterdeclares b on b.controller = ]]>&Controller;<![CDATA[ and s.sort = replace(b.name, '%2', '%l')

      insert into #_f(datasource, type, filterkey, xtype, refKey, exRefKey, refdatasource, fieldKey, joinClause, orderField, orderCookie, orderAlias, orderType, orderStruct, sortField)
        select isnull(b.xtable, ''), '1', '', 0, b.fieldkey, b.exfieldkey, b.reftable, b.reffieldkey, isnull(b.joinclause, ''),
            a.sort, a.cookie, a.alias, a.[type], a.structure,
            case when b.conditionalreplace is null then case when b.exname is null and (a.alias like '%[+*/\-]%' or a.alias like '%when%') then a.alias else '[a].' + replace(isnull(b.exname, b.name), '%2', '%l') end
              else replace(replace(replace(b.conditionalreplace, b.name, a.sort), '%2', ''), char(255) + a.sort, case when charindex(char(254), isnull(b.exname, '')) > 0 then '' else '%[a].' end + isnull(replace(replace(b.exname, '%2', ''), char(254), ''), a.sort)) end
          from #sort a join @@sysDatabaseName..sysfilterdeclares b on b.controller = ]]>&Controller;<![CDATA[ and a.sort = replace(b.name, '%2', '%l')
          where not exists(select 1 from #_f c where a.sort = c.orderField)
    end
end

if exists(select 1 from #_f) exec FastBusiness$System$GetDynamicFilter @@userID, @@admin, @$primeAlias output, @$primeJoin output, @$primeFilter output, @$detailPartition output, @$detailAlias output, @$detailFilter output
]]>

Name: CheckRelativeProcess

declare @checkRelative tinyint
exec @@sysDatabaseName..FastBusiness$Check$Relative @@userID, @@admin, &CheckRelativeParameter;, @checkRelative out
if @checkRelative = 0 begin
  &CheckRelativeQuery;
end

Name: PaymentFindingSort
Content:
declare @$q nvarchar(4000), @orderField varchar(1024)
select top 1 @orderField = rtrim(orderField) + case when orderType = 1 then '' else ' desc' end from #_f where orderType > 0
select @$q = 'select * from #res order by ' + case when @orderField is null then 'so_ct' else @orderField end + ', stt_rec'
exec sp_executesql @$q
